newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Telecom to offer new Beijing service.
newsitem.headline: HK Telecom to offer new Beijing service.

text.p: Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd said on Thursday it was teaming up with the Beijing Telecommunications Administration (BTA) to jointly offer an international frame relay service between Beijing and Hong Kong.
Hongkong Telecom said it was the first telecom in Hong Kong to offer frame relay service, packet-switching technology for high-speed data applications between Beijing and Hong Kong.
Hongkong Telecom would be responsible for sales and marketing in Hong Kong, with BTA handling the same tasks in Beijing, Hongkong Telecom said.
It said frame relay allowed simultaneous communication between multiple users at either end on a single access line.

Joseph Ma, Hongkong Telecom's director of international market development, said the utility was negotiating with telecoms authorities in other major Chinese cities and elsewhere in Asia to strengthen its frame relay network.
